C0447.title: Exposed: Top 100 Counterfeit Livestream Sales
C0447.summary: The Market Supervision Administration of Changshu, Jiangsu, investigated a livestream sales fraud case. The host displayed counterfeit products bearing trademarks such as 'Gucci' and 'Adidas' during the livestream, selling them as 'overstock tail goods'.
